verdict.rationale: Bento is a hosted SaaS observability platform that ingests traces, so letting customers choose the storage region or data residency is a fair question for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions regions, residency, regional endpoints, or self-hosting. The OpenTelemetry export docs describe pointing an exporter at 'one endpoint', which is not a residency choice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
